contea di ritrovamento: Hertfordshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper-alloy nummus of Constantine II as Caesar, dating to the period AD 321-323 (Reece period 16). BEATA TRANQVILLITAS reverse depicting a globe on an altar inscribed 'VOTIS XX', with three stars above. Mint of Lyon.
